path: Insurance Brokerage & Financial Services value chain
insurance-brokerage-financial-services-v.description: DACH Gewerbe- und Industriemakler are independent, §34d-GewO-licensed brokers that place property, liability, technical, transport and specialty cover for SMEs and corporates, earning recurring commission/fee books (Bestandsprovision) that renew annually. The market is highly fragmented (~47,000 licensed brokers in Germany alone) and undergoing a heavy succession (Nachfolge) wave that is fuelling PE-backed consolidation.

path: Insurance Brokerage & Financial Services value chain

rationale.recurring: Commission books renew annually as Bestandsprovision; SME accounts are sticky multi-line relationships rewon by inertia not tender.
rationale.fragmentation: 46,885 §34d Abs.1 brokers in Germany (Oct 2025), mostly single-office owner firms with no dominant consolidator at the SME layer.
rationale.compliance: §34d GewO licence + IDD 15h/yr CPD are mandatory to operate but are broker-side obligations rather than the client's buying driver.
